status: Approved and qualified on all three distributions with full DWARF, preserved AOT metadata, source lookup and GDB breakpoints; no debug-tool warning
root_cause: LLVM emits a standard DWARF .debug_names accelerator. debugedit 5.1 does not recognize the section; distribution GDB requires its own augmentation and explicitly ignores LLVM indexes. Full DWARF and Qore source data remain usable.
proposal: Use the same no-precomputed-index configuration approved for PDFium, scoped to OracleExtensions.qmod. Remove only .debug_names before RPM debug extraction, using Qore metadata preservation to retain EOF trailers; keep complete DWARF, debug sources and native/AOT functionality. Initial debugger loading may be slower.

fedora.standalone: Clang C++ reproduces debugedit notice; no-index GDB breakpoint, local variable and source lookup pass; Valgrind zero errors and all heap blocks freed
fedora.oracle: Original GDB warns and ignores LLVM index; no-index copy preserves .debug_info/.debug_abbrev/.debug_line/.debug_str/.debug_addr byte for byte, identical 82 AOT symbols, source and breakpoint lookup pass without warning
